description: Defines a minimal remote API contract for note synchronization, with suspend functions for pushing and fetching notes.

classes.name: NotesApi
classes.description: An interface representing remote API interactions for notes, including push and fetch operations.

methods.name: pushNotes
methods.description: Asynchronously pushes a list of notes to the remote backend.

methods.name: fetchNotesUpdatedSince
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches notes updated since a given timestamp.
